name: Logic gates
description: Two buttons feed an AND, an OR, an XOR and two NOTs. The results light digital feedback 3 to 7, so you can see each gate's truth table by pressing the buttons.
tryIt: On the test panel hold digital 1 and digital 2 in the four combinations and watch digital 3 (AND), 4 (OR), 5 (XOR), 6 (NOT 1) and 7 (NOT 2).
